_comment: Gripper link settings. Angles are servo degrees. Forces are raw FSR ADC counts (0-4095, 3.3k divider) until calibrated.
_calibrate: open_angle / closed_angle are NOT measured yet. The jaws only travel 23-63 mm (about 85 deg of servo at 0.47 mm of opening per servo degree), so the old 150/30 sweep would drive the racks into their ends. Find the real angles with `grip_cmd.py angle N` (slow, stops on force), set them here a couple of degrees inside the ends, and set angle_min/angle_max (the hard clamp on every pulse sent) to the ends.
_servo: MZ996 on Pi hardware PWM: GPIO19 (pin 35) = PWM0_1, 50 Hz, pulse_min_us..pulse_max_us = 0..180 deg. Powered from the Pi's 5 V pin.
